coverage_decision: Full main article and all supplied supplementary material included. References were extracted to a separate task queue and were not atomized as primary-study findings.

omissions.reason: Bibliography entries are provenance/task infrastructure; primary-study atoms require reading the cited publication directly.

visual_strategy: All figures/tables were visually inspected from rendered PDF pages. Content was reconstructed as structured evidence blocks rather than embedded screenshots because axes, groups, values, and footnotes were recoverable from source text plus visual reconciliation.
